what: R14 Contract + engine: `Storage::resume_readers(&mut self)`, clearing the stop flag (clock bit 32) without opening a view. base-db db/shared.rs `Shared::write`/`idle` (and shared/tests.rs) clear a stop after `&mut` when `readers_stopped()`; the fork did it with `trigger_cancellation`. Today only `new_view` clears it, so a `Shared::write` followed by setters that change nothing (base-db writes only what differs) leaves every later read unwinding `PendingWrite`; `synthetic_write` would clear it but re-verifies every row. The port (worktree blaze-v2-qu) calls `db.storage_mut().resume_readers()`.

history.note: Storage::resume_readers(&mut self) in crates/blaze-query/src/db/storage.rs (engine 01220), test resume_readers_clears_the_stop_without_a_view; contract in docs/v2/plan/lanes/db/query-unify.md
